FutureSkill’s recommendation engine uses: FutureSkill’s recommendation engine uses a 65% interest index and 35% subject index.

FutureSkill’s recommendation engine uses a 65% interest index and 35% subject index. The interest index combines 85% scaled Pearson profile-shape similarity and 15% above-your-own-mean emphasis; a flat profile is neutral at 50. Subject fields use title-matching heuristics, with unclassified fields neutral, and diversity selection can change recommendation order. The three-letter profile code is not an input to ranking. Where there is a tie at the code cutoff, this report names every tied area.
